prompt: Create one accurate sparse Chinese heritage INK LINE DRAWING of the existing stone entrance gate of Quanzhou Qingjing Mosque (清净寺), using image 1 as the actual subject photograph and image 2 only as the project's fine black-line style sample. Draw the central rectangular gray-stone gate tower with its high pointed recessed arch, the smaller pointed arch deeper inside, horizontal stone courses, and low connected stone wings on both sides; preserve the identifiable crenellated top and overall proportions. Isolate the historic masonry from all tourists, carts, signs, text, railings, paving, sky, trees and modern additions. Keep complete architectural silhouette with generous margin. Thin charcoal-black contour lines and sparse joint lines only, no legible inscriptions or invented Arabic letters. The entire exterior canvas and arch opening background must be flat opaque pure #FFFFFF, with no shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, gray wash, colored ink, black fill, checkerboard, or transparency. Compose in landscape 4:3.
